Venue spaces booked: Ballroom ($4,500 for 6 hours, includes tables, chairs, white linens, setup/breakdown) and Garden Terrace ceremony ($1,500, weather permitting, indoor backup in Conservatory), totaling $6,000.

Catering: Signature Package at $125/person (selected by Jennifer) includes cocktail hour with 5 appetizers (choice from shrimp cocktail, bruschetta, stuffed mushrooms, cheese display, crudités, mini quiches, spring rolls, meatballs), three-course plated dinner, and wedding cake.
Main entrées chosen: 8oz filet mignon (garlic mashed potatoes, seasonal vegetables) and herb-crusted salmon (rice pilaf, seasonal vegetables) for guest selection.
Bar service: Beer and wine only at $28/person, making food/beverage total $153/person ($125 + $28) for 150 guests: $22,950.

Cost breakdown: $6,000 venue fee + $22,950 food/beverage + 8.5% sales tax ($1,951) + 22% service charge on food/beverage ($5,049) = $28,950 base. Additional services: basic centerpieces ($35 each x15 tables = $525), bridal bouquet ($250) + 5 bridesmaids' bouquets ($75 each = $375, total $625), preferred DJ ($1,200), photography ($3,500 budget), bringing grand total to $41,800.

Payment schedule: $5,000 deposit to hold date (refundable if cancelled by September 14th, 2024; non-refundable after), 50% of remaining balance ($18,400) due March 14th, 2025, final balance ($18,400) due August 31st, 2025.

Wedding cake: Three tiers (serves 150), can have different flavors per tier (vanilla, chocolate, red velvet with buttercream). Menu selections due 60 days before, final headcount due 14 days before. Amanda to email detailed proposal to jpark.wedding@email.com within 2 hours, valid for 14 days.
